content:
NVIDIA has revolutionized object detection with a radical rethinking of how vision-language models handle bounding boxes, achieving unprecedented speed and accuracy. Their new model, LocateAnything, challenges the long-held assumption that boxes must be predicted token by token, instead treating them as atomic units.

• Introduces LocateAnything, a 3B vision-language model that predicts bounding boxes in one parallel step instead of sequentially  
• Achieves 12.7 boxes/sec on a single H100—10x faster than Qwen3-VL—with improved accuracy (+3.8% F1 on LVIS)  
• Excels in dense scenes (up to 300 boxes) and includes a safety fallback to sequential decoding if errors are detected  
• Trained on 785M boxes across 138M queries, spanning referring expressions, GUI navigation, and OCR tasks
